title: My Mall World(s)
content: Hello! I’m so glad to have found this sub! I sometimes dream of a large mall/complex and other connected buildings and facilities that seem similar to what others have shared. I find some of the similarities fascinating! I wanted to share the basics of my version(s) of mall world and some of the main features of these dreams: Note: I’m not a great writer at all so I tried to break it into a list! Thanks in advance for reading! LONG POST WARNING (sorry!) Main Mall -multi level mall with railings overlooking the other levels -lots of stores, water features -fancy clothing store, facing the outside w/ salesman and large glass walls. -Bathroom(s) -restaurants -mall food court -play area with slides that I can see but have not used -Movie theater w/ lobby connected to the mall with vending machines or something on the walls Music venue -large theater with stage -catwalks above seating area -backstage area -venue seems to connect to the mall or area with shops and restaurants Casino -wide carpeted and tiled corridors -heigh ceilings -confusing layout -stairs leading random places -“Gaming floor” areas Elevator -up some stairs off the casino I think? -large room sized elevator with mirrored walls Airport -seemed to be connected to the hotel/ resort lobby -very long wide corridors and a people mover -baggage claim area Hotel/Lobby -Desk and seating area -very large long space connecting to airport Resort Area -indoor open dining area -Outdoor pool -tropical beach cove Mountain resort area? Sorry if a lot of this is kind of vague, but I tried to put together as much as I could recall from multiple dreams, and some details are hard to remember. Anyways., Thanks again for reading about the features of my mall world dreams! In the future, I hope to share more! There are entire cities that I visit in my dreams that seem super real!
